title: Level 2 (Intermediate) - D-7
notes:
West leads the ♠7 against 3NT. It may seem natural to play a low spade from the dummy to the first trick, but to do so jeopardizes the contract should East be able to win the trick. A heart lead through South's ♥Q would be most unwelcome. When the defense wins the ♣A they will run the hearts to defeat 3NT.

South can guarantee the contract by rising with the ♠A at trick 1 and unblocking the diamonds before driving out the ♣A. There is no layout of the East-West spades that will allow the defense to win 4 spade tricks. If the defense attacks hearts after winning the ♣A, South can cash the ♦Q and 3 club tricks to make the contract.
